text: 中国人民银行公告，将在7月29日至7月31日、8月3日开展隔夜逆回购操作，采用固定利率、数量招标。7月29日至7月31日每日开展6000亿元，8月3日开展3000亿元。
text_en: The People's Bank of China announced it will conduct overnight reverse repo operations on July 29-31 and August 3, using a fixed rate and quantity-based bidding. Daily operations will be 600 billion yuan from July 29 to July 31, and 300 billion yuan on August 3.
